item: A host's own Crawl-delay reads as a deferral on the Law table, in the coverage mix and in the Track-changes-now toast, not as a fetch error
summary: R406 (Q1013 = a said a deferral is not a failure; OPEN_QUEUE item 10). Measured before, two documents whose host defers: the tally said deferred 2, errors 0 while the table row and the coverage verdict mix both said error, because track.py stored the deferral as 'fetch error: Crawl-delay ...' on purpose until a verdict and its label were ruled; the toast never read the deferred key, so a pass where every host deferred said 'Tracked 0 law(s) ... 0 errors.' and nothing about why. Now track.py stores 'deferred: <reason>', _verdict_of judges that prefix first (no word in the reason can turn it into a verdict about the document), the pill is neutral with the stored reason on hover, the coverage mix counts it under deferred, and the toast adds '{n} deferred (the host's own Crawl-delay)' only when the key is present, apart from the airplane-mode clause by a comma and kept after the airplane sentence when Stop was pressed mid-pass; the coverage method text also names re_extracted. Rows stored before keep 'fetch error: Crawl-delay <n> s: not before <time>' in the database and are read as deferrals at once by that exact start of text (the one message the single raise site writes; a message that only mentions a Crawl-delay stays an error), because waiting for a pass to rewrite them would not work: auto_track_due asks one document per host per pass and never an unwatched one (found by the Opus read of #1684). Two strings x12 locales. Tests: the stamp test flipped from error to deferred, the table row and coverage mix, the old wording, the rewrite, a node test of the pill and the toast under a translator. No scheduler or tally change. Mutants killed: 28 of 28 (the branch removed, moved after the robots test, matched anywhere or widened to the Crawl-delay words; the old wording stored; the pill warn or ok; the label bypassing the translator or missing; the toast clause missing, shown at zero, not keyed or counted as errors; the coverage method text; a locale key removed or left in English in de and zh).
